About Northwind Plumbing

Northwind Plumbing was started in 2009 by Sam Okafor, a heating engineer who had spent twelve years working for a national boiler chain and wanted to run a company where the quote you were given was the price you paid. The business began with one van in Kirkstall and now runs eleven engineers across Leeds.

Who runs the company

Sam Okafor is the managing director and still attends emergency call-outs two days a week. Priya Nair leads the heating team and holds a City and Guilds Level 3 in gas engineering. Tom Whitaker manages the drainage team and is a member of the National Association of Drainage Contractors.

What we believe

A plumbing emergency is stressful enough without a surprise invoice. So every job has a fixed quote in writing before work begins, every engineer is directly employed rather than subcontracted, and every review we publish is verified by a third party. We think that is the minimum a trade should offer, and we have found that customers agree.
